title: kerala sambar
ingredients: toor dal,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,shallots,drumstick,carrot,tomato,sambar powder,tamarind,salt,water
instructions: first wash the toor dal with clean water two times then add the dal to a pressure cooker with water and cook until the dal becomes very soft and mashable after cooking lightly mash the dal and keep it aside next soak tamarind in warm water and extract the juice keep it ready now place a cooking pot on the stove and heat coconut oil add mustard seeds and wait until they crackle then add dry red chilli curry leaves and shallots stir slowly and cook until shallots turn soft add drumstick carrot and tomato mix well add sambar powder and stir gently for one minute now add the cooked dal tamarind water salt and enough water to get a curry consistency mix well and let it boil on medium flame for ten to fifteen minutes stir occasionally turn off the stove once the vegetables are fully cooked and the sambar smells aromatic

title: avial
ingredients: mixed vegetables,coconut,green chilli,cumin seeds,coconut oil,curry leaves,yogurt,salt,water
instructions: wash all vegetables properly then cut them into long even pieces add the vegetables into a pot add water and salt and cook on medium flame until the vegetables are just soft and not overcooked while vegetables are cooking add coconut green chilli and cumin seeds into a mixer and grind into a coarse thick paste without adding too much water once vegetables are cooked reduce the flame to low add the ground coconut paste and mix gently cook for two minutes now add yogurt slowly and mix carefully do not boil after adding yogurt turn off the stove finally add coconut oil and curry leaves mix once and keep covered for a few minutes before serving

title: puttu
instructions: take rice flour in a bowl add salt and mix well sprinkle water little by little and mix using fingers until the flour becomes moist and crumbly it should not become dough next take a puttu maker add grated coconut as the first layer then add rice flour mixture then again coconut and rice flour until the maker is filled place the puttu maker on a steamer with boiling water steam for about ten to fifteen minutes until steam comes strongly from the top remove from heat and carefully push out the puttu using the rod serve hot

title: kadala curry
ingredients: black chickpeas,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,coriander powder,chilli powder,garam masala,coconut,salt,water
instructions: wash black chickpeas and soak them in water overnight for at least eight hours next day drain the water and cook the chickpeas in a pressure cooker with fresh water and salt until they are soft and fully cooked keep aside now heat coconut oil in a deep pan add mustard seeds and wait until they splutter add dry red chilli curry leaves onion ginger and garlic stir and cook until onion turns light brown add coriander powder chilli powder and garam masala mix well and cook for one minute add the cooked chickpeas along with some cooking water mix well and let it boil meanwhile grind coconut with a little water to a smooth paste add this paste to the curry stir well and cook on low flame for ten minutes until the curry thickens turn off the stove and let it rest before serving

title: kerala vegetable stew
instructions: heat coconut oil in a pan add cinnamon cloves and cardamom allow them to release aroma add ginger green chilli and onion stir and cook until onion becomes soft add potato carrot and beans mix well add water and salt cover and cook until vegetables are tender once vegetables are cooked reduce flame and add coconut milk slowly stir gently do not boil after adding coconut milk cook for two to three minutes turn off the stove and keep covered before serving

title: kerala fish curry
ingredients: fish,coconut oil,mustard seeds,fenugreek seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,shallots,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,tamarind,salt,water
instructions: clean and wash the fish pieces properly soak tamarind in warm water and extract thick juice heat coconut oil in a clay pot add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds allow them to crackle add dry red chilli curry leaves shallots ginger and garlic stir and cook until shallots soften add chilli powder and coriander powder mix gently on low flame add tamarind water salt and additional water if needed bring it to a boil now add fish pieces carefully do not stir too much cover and cook on medium flame until fish is cooked and gravy thickens slightly gently swirl the pot once turn off the stove and let it rest for some time before serving

title: masala chai
instructions: add water to a saucepan and place on medium flame add crushed ginger and cardamom let it boil for two minutes add tea powder and boil again for one minute now add milk and sugar mix well let the tea boil until it rises reduce flame and simmer for two minutes turn off the stove strain the tea into cups and serve hot

title: cabbage thoran
ingredients: cabbage,coconut,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,coconut oil,salt
instructions: wash the cabbage thoroughly and cut into thin small pieces keep aside place a pan on the stove and heat coconut oil add mustard seeds and wait until they splutter add dry red chilli and curry leaves stir once add cabbage and salt mix well cover and cook on low flame for five minutes open the lid and stir gently continue cooking until cabbage becomes soft and moisture evaporates add coconut mix well cook for two minutes turn off the stove and serve hot

title: egg curry kerala style
ingredients: eggs,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,tomato,salt,water
instructions: boil eggs in water until fully cooked allow them to cool remove shells and keep aside heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds and let them crackle add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic stir and cook until onion becomes golden add chilli powder and coriander powder mix well add tomato and cook until it becomes soft and oil separates add water and salt mix and bring to a boil add boiled eggs gently cover and simmer for ten minutes turn off the stove and let the curry rest before serving

title: lemon rice
ingredients: rice,oil,mustard seeds,urad dal,peanuts,dry red chilli,curry leaves,turmeric powder,green chilli,lemon juice,salt
instructions: cook rice separately with water and salt until grains are soft and separate allow it to cool heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds urad dal peanuts and fry until peanuts turn light brown add dry red chilli curry leaves green chilli and turmeric powder mix well add cooked rice and salt mix gently on low flame turn off the stove add lemon juice mix well and serve warm

title: vegetable pulao
instructions: wash rice and soak for twenty minutes heat oil in a pot add bay leaf cloves cinnamon and cardamom stir until aromatic add onion ginger and green chilli cook until onion softens add mixed vegetables stir for two minutes add rice water and salt mix well cover and cook on low flame until rice is fully cooked and water is absorbed turn off the stove and gently fluff the rice before serving

title: mango lassi
instructions: add yogurt mango pulp sugar and water into a blender blend until smooth and creamy taste and adjust sweetness if needed pour into glasses and serve chilled

title: idli
instructions: wash rice and urad dal separately and soak both in water for at least six hours after soaking grind urad dal with water until it becomes smooth and fluffy then grind rice separately with water until smooth mix both batters together add salt and mix well cover and allow the batter to ferment overnight or until it rises and becomes airy once fermented gently mix the batter pour it into idli molds place the molds in a steamer with boiling water steam for ten to twelve minutes remove from heat allow to cool slightly then remove idlis carefully and serve hot

title: dosa
instructions: wash and soak rice and urad dal separately for six hours grind urad dal into smooth batter grind rice into slightly coarse batter mix both together add salt and water to make pouring consistency allow batter to ferment overnight once fermented heat a flat pan grease lightly with oil pour a ladle of batter spread gently into a thin circle drizzle oil around edges cook until bottom turns golden flip and cook briefly remove and serve hot

title: rajma masala
ingredients: kidney beans,oil,cumin seeds,onion,ginger,garlic,coriander powder,chilli powder,garam masala,tomato,salt,water
instructions: wash kidney beans and soak overnight drain and cook them in a pressure cooker with water and salt until soft heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds allow them to crackle add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns golden add tomato and cook until soft add coriander powder chilli powder and garam masala mix well add cooked kidney beans with some water stir and simmer for fifteen minutes until gravy thickens turn off stove and rest before serving

title: curd rice
instructions: cook rice with water until very soft allow it to cool slightly mash the rice gently add yogurt and salt mix well heat oil in a small pan add mustard seeds urad dal green chilli and curry leaves allow them to splutter pour this seasoning over the rice mix gently and serve

title: black tea
instructions: add water to a saucepan and bring it to a boil add tea powder and sugar mix well boil for two minutes reduce flame simmer for one minute turn off stove strain into cups and serve hot

title: filter coffee
instructions: add water to a saucepan and bring it to a boil add coffee powder and boil for two minutes turn off the stove and strain the coffee decoction into a cup add hot milk and sugar mix well pour back and forth between two cups to mix evenly and serve hot

title: instant coffee
instructions: boil water in a saucepan add coffee powder and sugar mix well add milk and let it heat for two minutes turn off the stove stir well and serve hot

title: lemonade
instructions: squeeze lemon juice into a bowl remove seeds add sugar salt and water mix well until sugar dissolves taste and adjust sweetness pour into glasses and serve chilled or at room temperature

title: buttermilk
instructions: add yogurt and water into a bowl mix well until smooth add salt and curry leaves stir well pour into glasses and serve cool

title: vegetable omelette
instructions: crack eggs into a bowl add onion green chilli and salt beat well heat oil in a pan pour the egg mixture spread evenly cook on low flame until bottom sets flip gently cook the other side until fully done remove from pan and serve hot

title: plain milk
instructions: pour milk into a saucepan place it on low to medium flame allow the milk to heat slowly stir occasionally to avoid burning once the milk becomes hot add sugar if needed stir until dissolved turn off the stove and serve hot

title: rice kanji
instructions: wash rice thoroughly add rice and water to a pot and cook on medium flame until the rice is very soft and breaks easily add salt mix well cook for a few more minutes turn off the stove allow it to cool slightly and serve warm

title: upma
instructions: heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds and let them splutter add urad dal and stir until lightly golden add onion green chilli and curry leaves cook until onion becomes soft add water and salt bring it to a boil reduce flame add rava slowly while stirring continuously cook on low flame until the rava absorbs water and becomes soft turn off the stove and serve hot

title: poha
ingredients: flattened rice,oil,mustard seeds,onion,green chilli,curry leaves,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash flattened rice quickly in water drain and keep aside heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add onion green chilli and curry leaves cook until onion soft add turmeric powder and salt mix well add flattened rice mix gently cook on low flame for five minutes turn off the stove and serve warm

title: milk tea
instructions: add water to a saucepan and bring it to a boil add tea powder and boil for one minute add milk and sugar stir well let it boil on medium flame until the tea color deepens turn off the stove strain into a cup and serve hot

title: black coffee
instructions: boil water in a saucepan add coffee powder and sugar mix well boil for one minute turn off the stove strain into a cup and serve hot

title: lemon water
instructions: squeeze lemon juice into a glass remove seeds add water and sugar stir well until sugar dissolves and serve fresh

title: bread omelette
instructions: break eggs into a bowl add onion green chilli and salt beat well heat oil in a pan dip bread slices into the egg mixture place them on the pan cook on low flame until one side sets flip carefully and cook the other side until fully cooked remove and serve hot

title: vegetable stir fry
instructions: wash and cut vegetables into small pieces heat oil in a pan add vegetables and salt stir well cook on medium flame stirring occasionally until vegetables are soft but not mushy turn off the stove and serve hot

title: kerala beef curry
ingredients: beef,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,black pepper,coriander powder,chilli powder,garam masala,salt,water
instructions: wash the beef thoroughly and cut into medium sized pieces place beef in a pressure cooker add water and salt cook until the beef becomes soft keep aside heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds and let them splutter add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic stir and cook until onion turns dark brown add coriander powder chilli powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add cooked beef along with some cooking water stir well cover and cook on low flame until the gravy thickens and oil appears on top turn off the stove and let it rest before serving

title: meen pollichathu
ingredients: fish,coconut oil,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,curry leaves,banana leaf,salt
instructions: clean and wash the fish apply salt turmeric powder chilli powder and coriander powder evenly and keep aside heat coconut oil in a pan add onion ginger garlic green chilli and curry leaves cook until onion softens place the marinated fish in the masala coat well turn off stove wrap the fish with masala in a banana leaf heat a pan add a little oil place the wrapped fish cook on low flame flipping carefully until fish is fully cooked remove and serve hot

title: nadan chicken curry
ingredients: chicken,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,garam masala,tomato,salt,water
instructions: wash the chicken pieces thoroughly heat coconut oil in a pot add mustard seeds let them splutter add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns golden add chilli powder coriander powder and garam masala mix well add tomato and cook until soft add chicken and salt mix well cook for five minutes add water cover and cook on medium flame until chicken is fully cooked and gravy thickens turn off stove and rest before serving

title: egg roast
ingredients: eggs,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,garam masala,salt,water
instructions: boil eggs in water until fully cooked cool and remove shells cut eggs lengthwise heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds and let them splutter add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns dark brown add chilli powder coriander powder garam masala and salt mix well add a little water to avoid burning add boiled eggs mix gently cook on low flame until masala coats the eggs well turn off the stove and serve

title: pork ularthiyathu
ingredients: pork,coconut oil,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,black pepper,chilli powder,garam masala,salt,water
instructions: wash pork thoroughly and cut into small pieces cook pork in a pressure cooker with water and salt until soft heat coconut oil in a pan add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion becomes brown add chilli powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add cooked pork stir well cook on low flame stirring often until the pork becomes dry and roasted turn off the stove and serve hot

title: kerala fish fry
ingredients: fish,coconut oil,chilli powder,turmeric powder,black pepper,curry leaves,salt
instructions: wash the fish thoroughly under running water and drain all excess water place the fish in a bowl add chilli powder turmeric powder black pepper and salt mix gently so the spices coat the fish evenly keep aside for ten minutes heat coconut oil in a flat pan on medium flame add curry leaves carefully place the fish pieces in the pan cook on medium flame until the bottom side turns golden brown flip carefully and cook the other side until the fish is fully cooked and crisp remove from pan and serve hot

title: mutton rogan josh
instructions: wash mutton thoroughly heat oil in a deep pot add bay leaf cloves cinnamon and cardamom stir until aromatic add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns golden add chilli powder and fennel powder mix gently add yogurt slowly while stirring to avoid curdling add mutton and salt mix well cook for five minutes add water cover and cook on low to medium flame until mutton becomes soft and gravy thickens turn off the stove and allow it to rest before serving

title: dal tadka
ingredients: toor dal,oil,cumin seeds,garlic,dry red chilli,onion,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash toor dal and cook it with water turmeric powder and salt until very soft mash lightly heat oil in a small pan add cumin seeds allow them to crackle add garlic dry red chilli and onion cook until onion turns light brown pour this tempering into the cooked dal mix well boil for five minutes on low flame turn off the stove and serve hot

title: aloo gobi
ingredients: potato,cauliflower,oil,cumin seeds,onion,ginger,green chilli,turmeric powder,chilli powder,coriander powder,salt,water
instructions: wash potato and cauliflower and cut into medium pieces heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds let them crackle add onion ginger and green chilli cook until onion softens add turmeric powder chilli powder and coriander powder mix well add potato and cauliflower salt and a small amount of water mix cover and cook on low flame stirring occasionally until vegetables are fully cooked and dry turn off the stove and serve

title: egg bhurji
instructions: break eggs into a bowl add salt and beat lightly heat oil in a pan add onion ginger and green chilli cook until onion softens add tomato turmeric powder and chilli powder cook until tomato becomes soft pour beaten eggs into the pan cook on low flame stirring continuously until eggs are fully cooked and crumbly turn off the stove and serve hot

title: olan
ingredients: ash gourd,coconut milk,green chilli,coconut oil,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: wash the ash gourd remove seeds and cut into medium pieces place them in a pot add water salt and green chilli cook on low to medium flame until the vegetable becomes soft once cooked reduce the flame add coconut milk slowly and mix gently do not allow it to boil cook for two to three minutes turn off the stove add coconut oil and curry leaves mix once keep covered for a few minutes and serve

title: bengali fish curry
ingredients: fish,mustard oil,nigella seeds,green chilli,turmeric powder,chilli powder,salt,water
instructions: clean and wash the fish pieces apply turmeric powder and salt lightly heat mustard oil in a pan until it smokes lightly reduce flame add nigella seeds and green chilli carefully place fish pieces in the oil cook briefly on both sides until lightly sealed remove fish and keep aside in the same pan add water turmeric powder chilli powder and salt bring to a boil add fish pieces cover and cook on low flame until fish is fully cooked turn off stove and rest before serving

title: gatte ki sabzi
ingredients: gram flour,yogurt,oil,cumin seeds,asafoetida,red chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: mix gram flour yogurt salt red chilli powder and turmeric powder in a bowl add water gradually to make a thick dough shape the dough into long rolls boil water in a pot add the rolls and cook until they float remove and cool slightly cut into small pieces heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds and asafoetida add coriander powder and remaining spices add water and bring to a boil add yogurt slowly while stirring add gatte pieces simmer on low flame for ten minutes turn off stove and serve

title: assamese pork curry
instructions: wash pork thoroughly cut into medium pieces heat mustard oil in a pot add garlic ginger dry red chilli and black pepper stir briefly add pork and salt mix well cook on medium flame until pork releases moisture add water cover and cook on low flame until pork becomes soft and curry thickens turn off the stove and allow it to rest before serving

title: andhra chicken curry
ingredients: chicken,oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly heat oil in a pot add mustard seeds allow them to splutter add curry leaves onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion softens add turmeric powder chilli powder and coriander powder mix well add chicken and salt stir and cook for five minutes add water cover and cook on medium flame until chicken is fully cooked and gravy thickens turn off stove and serve hot

title: olan
ingredients: ash gourd,coconut milk,green chilli,coconut oil,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: wash the ash gourd remove seeds and cut into medium pieces place them in a pot add water salt and green chilli cook on low to medium flame until the vegetable becomes soft once cooked reduce the flame add coconut milk slowly and mix gently do not allow it to boil cook for two to three minutes turn off the stove add coconut oil and curry leaves mix once keep covered for a few minutes and serve

title: bengali fish curry
ingredients: fish,mustard oil,nigella seeds,green chilli,turmeric powder,chilli powder,salt,water
instructions: clean and wash the fish pieces apply turmeric powder and salt lightly heat mustard oil in a pan until it smokes lightly reduce flame add nigella seeds and green chilli carefully place fish pieces in the oil cook briefly on both sides until lightly sealed remove fish and keep aside in the same pan add water turmeric powder chilli powder and salt bring to a boil add fish pieces cover and cook on low flame until fish is fully cooked turn off stove and rest before serving

title: gatte ki sabzi
ingredients: gram flour,yogurt,oil,cumin seeds,asafoetida,red chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: mix gram flour yogurt salt red chilli powder and turmeric powder in a bowl add water gradually to make a thick dough shape the dough into long rolls boil water in a pot add the rolls and cook until they float remove and cool slightly cut into small pieces heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds and asafoetida add coriander powder and remaining spices add water and bring to a boil add yogurt slowly while stirring add gatte pieces simmer on low flame for ten minutes turn off stove and serve

title: assamese pork curry
instructions: wash pork thoroughly cut into medium pieces heat mustard oil in a pot add garlic ginger dry red chilli and black pepper stir briefly add pork and salt mix well cook on medium flame until pork releases moisture add water cover and cook on low flame until pork becomes soft and curry thickens turn off the stove and allow it to rest before serving

title: andhra chicken curry
ingredients: chicken,oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly heat oil in a pot add mustard seeds allow them to splutter add curry leaves onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion softens add turmeric powder chilli powder and coriander powder mix well add chicken and salt stir and cook for five minutes add water cover and cook on medium flame until chicken is fully cooked and gravy thickens turn off stove and serve hot

title: appam
instructions: wash rice thoroughly and soak in water for at least six hours after soaking grind rice with coconut and water to a smooth batter add yeast sugar and salt mix well cover and allow the batter to ferment for eight to ten hours until slightly bubbly once fermented mix gently heat an appam pan grease lightly with oil pour a ladle of batter swirl the pan to spread cover and cook on low flame until the center is soft and edges are crisp remove carefully and serve hot

title: chicken biryani hyderabadi
ingredients: basmati rice,chicken,yogurt,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,red chilli powder,garam masala,turmeric powder,lemon juice,oil,salt,water
instructions: wash and soak basmati rice for thirty minutes wash chicken and marinate with yogurt ginger garlic green chilli red chilli powder turmeric powder garam masala lemon juice and salt keep aside for thirty minutes cook rice separately in salted water until seventy percent cooked drain and keep aside heat oil in a deep pot add onion and cook until golden add marinated chicken mix well and cook until chicken is half cooked layer cooked rice over the chicken sprinkle a little water cover tightly and cook on very low flame until rice and chicken are fully cooked turn off the stove allow it to rest for ten minutes then mix gently and serve

title: masala dosa
instructions: wash and soak rice and urad dal separately for six hours grind into smooth batter mix together add salt and ferment overnight for the filling boil potatoes until soft peel and mash heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds onion green chilli and ginger cook until onion softens add turmeric powder salt and mashed potato mix well heat a flat pan grease lightly pour dosa batter spread thin drizzle oil cook until crisp place potato filling fold and serve hot

title: chole masala
instructions: wash and soak chickpeas overnight cook them in a pressure cooker with water and salt until soft heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds allow them to crackle add onion ginger and garlic cook until golden add tomato and cook until soft add coriander powder chilli powder and garam masala mix well add cooked chickpeas and some water simmer for fifteen minutes until gravy thickens turn off stove and serve hot

title: kerala fish molee
ingredients: fish,coconut oil,onion,ginger,green chilli,turmeric powder,coconut milk,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: clean and wash fish pieces heat coconut oil in a pan add onion ginger green chilli and curry leaves cook until onion softens add turmeric powder mix gently add water and salt bring to a boil add fish pieces carefully cover and cook on low flame until fish is cooked reduce flame add coconut milk stir gently do not boil cook for two minutes turn off stove and keep covered before serving

title: paneer butter masala
ingredients: paneer,butter,oil,cumin seeds,onion,ginger,garlic,tomato,cashew nuts,red chilli powder,garam masala,cream,salt,water
instructions: heat oil and butter in a pan add cumin seeds and allow them to crackle add onion ginger and garlic cook on medium flame until onion turns light golden add tomato and cashew nuts mix well cook until tomato becomes soft turn off stove cool slightly and grind to a smooth paste return the paste to the pan add red chilli powder garam masala salt and water mix well bring to a gentle boil add paneer cubes and simmer on low flame for ten minutes add cream mix gently turn off stove and serve

title: goan fish curry
instructions: clean and wash fish pieces soak tamarind in water and extract juice grind coconut dried red chilli turmeric powder ginger and garlic with water to a smooth paste heat coconut oil in a pan add onion and cook until soft add the ground paste and cook on low flame until oil separates add tamarind water salt and additional water bring to a boil add fish pieces carefully cover and cook on low flame until fish is fully cooked turn off stove and rest before serving

title: lucknowi mutton biryani
instructions: wash and soak basmati rice for thirty minutes wash mutton and marinate with yogurt ginger garlic green chilli garam masala and salt for one hour cook mutton in a pot with water until tender cook rice separately in salted water until seventy percent done heat oil in a deep pot add whole spices and onion cook until onion turns golden add cooked mutton mix well layer rice over mutton sprinkle some cooking liquid cover tightly and cook on very low flame until fully done turn off stove and rest before serving

title: north indian egg curry
instructions: boil eggs in water until fully cooked cool remove shells and keep aside heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds allow them to crackle add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns golden add tomato cook until soft add red chilli powder garam masala and salt mix well add water and bring to a boil add eggs cover and simmer for ten minutes turn off stove and serve hot

title: pav bhaji
instructions: cook potato cauliflower and peas with water until very soft mash them together heat oil and butter in a pan add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion softens add tomato cook until mushy add pav bhaji masala and salt mix well add mashed vegetables and water mix thoroughly cook on medium flame mashing continuously until thick and smooth turn off stove and serve hot

title: kappa puzhukku
instructions: peel the tapioca completely remove the thick outer skin and inner pink layer cut into medium pieces wash thoroughly place the tapioca in a pot add enough water and salt cook on medium flame until the pieces are very soft drain all excess water while hot add crushed coconut green chilli garlic and cumin seeds mix gently heat coconut oil in a small pan add curry leaves pour over the tapioca mix once cover and rest for five minutes before serving

title: butter chicken
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly heat oil and butter in a pan add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion softens add tomato and cashew nuts cook until tomato becomes soft turn off stove cool slightly and grind into smooth paste return paste to pan add red chilli powder garam masala salt and water mix well bring to a gentle boil add chicken pieces cover and cook on medium flame until chicken is fully cooked add cream mix gently cook for two minutes turn off stove and rest before serving

title: dal makhani
ingredients: whole black lentils,kidney beans,butter,oil,cumin seeds,onion,ginger,garlic,tomato,red chilli powder,garam masala,cream,salt,water
instructions: wash and soak whole black lentils and kidney beans overnight pressure cook with water and salt until very soft heat oil and butter in a pan add cumin seeds allow them to crackle add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns light brown add tomato cook until soft add red chilli powder and garam masala mix well add cooked lentils and beans with water simmer on low flame for thirty minutes stirring occasionally add cream mix gently turn off stove and serve

title: bhindi masala
ingredients: okra,oil,cumin seeds,onion,ginger,green chilli,turmeric powder,chilli powder,coriander powder,salt
instructions: wash okra thoroughly and wipe completely dry cut into medium pieces heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds let them crackle add okra and cook on medium flame stirring occasionally until they lose stickiness and become soft remove and keep aside in same pan add onion ginger and green chilli cook until onion softens add turmeric powder chilli powder coriander powder and salt mix well add cooked okra mix gently cook on low flame for five minutes turn off stove and serve

title: tandoori chicken
ingredients: chicken,yogurt,ginger,garlic,red chilli powder,turmeric powder,garam masala,lemon juice,oil,salt
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly make deep cuts on pieces mix yogurt ginger garlic red chilli powder turmeric powder garam masala lemon juice salt and oil into a thick marinade coat chicken evenly cover and marinate for at least four hours preheat oven or grill place chicken on rack cook on medium heat turning occasionally until fully cooked and lightly charred remove and rest for five minutes before serving

title: palak paneer
instructions: wash spinach thoroughly and cook it in boiling water until it wilts immediately transfer to cool water to retain color grind the spinach with green chilli into a smooth paste heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds and let them crackle add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion becomes soft add the spinach paste salt and water mix well cook on low flame for ten minutes add paneer cubes and garam masala mix gently simmer for five minutes turn off the stove and serve hot

title: chettinad chicken curry
ingredients: chicken,oil,fennel seeds,onion,ginger,garlic,dry red chilli,black pepper,coriander seeds,coconut,salt,water
instructions: dry roast dry red chilli black pepper coriander seeds and fennel seeds on low flame until aromatic allow to cool and grind with coconut into a smooth paste wash chicken thoroughly heat oil in a pot add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns golden add the ground masala paste stir and cook for five minutes add chicken salt and water mix well cover and cook on medium flame until chicken is fully cooked and gravy thickens turn off stove and rest before serving

title: fish curry patra ni machhi
instructions: clean and wash fish pieces grind coriander leaves green chilli garlic ginger lemon juice turmeric powder and salt into a thick paste coat the fish evenly with this paste place the fish on banana leaf wrap tightly steam the wrapped fish for about twenty minutes until fully cooked remove carefully unwrap and serve hot

title: litti chokha
instructions: knead wheat flour with water and salt into a firm dough for filling mix sattu lemon juice garlic green chilli mustard oil and salt add little water to bind shape dough balls stuff with sattu filling seal and roast over fire or bake until cooked for chokha roast brinjal and tomato until skin chars peel mash add oil and salt mix well serve litti hot with chokha

title: fish cutlet
instructions: cook fish with water and salt until done remove bones and flake the fish boil potatoes until soft and mash heat oil in a pan add onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion softens add flaked fish mashed potato black pepper and salt mix well allow mixture to cool shape into patties heat oil shallow fry the patties on medium flame until golden brown on both sides remove and serve hot

title: pazham pori
instructions: peel the nendran banana and cut it lengthwise into even pieces keep aside in a bowl add wheat flour rice flour sugar salt and water mix well to make a smooth thick batter without lumps heat oil in a deep pan on medium flame dip each banana piece into the batter so it coats evenly gently place into hot oil fry on medium flame turning carefully until the fritters become golden brown remove using a slotted spoon drain excess oil and serve hot

title: misal pav
ingredients: sprouted moth beans,oil,mustard seeds,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,turmeric powder,chilli powder,garam masala,tamarind,salt,water
instructions: wash the sprouted moth beans and cook them with water and salt until soft heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds and allow them to splutter add onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion softens add turmeric powder chilli powder and garam masala mix well add cooked sprouts with some cooking water mix and simmer for ten minutes soak tamarind in water extract juice add to the curry simmer for five minutes turn off stove and serve hot with pav

title: khichdi
instructions: wash rice and moong dal together until water runs clear heat oil in a pressure cooker add cumin seeds and let them crackle add ginger and turmeric powder stir briefly add rice and dal salt and water mix well close the cooker and cook until very soft allow pressure to release naturally open and stir gently adjust consistency with hot water if needed and serve warm

title: dhokla
instructions: add gram flour yogurt ginger green chilli salt and water into a bowl mix well to make a smooth batter rest for ten minutes add fruit salt and mix gently pour batter into a greased steaming plate steam for fifteen minutes until set cool slightly cut into pieces heat oil in a small pan add mustard seeds allow to splutter add water sugar and salt boil briefly pour this tempering evenly over the dhokla pieces and serve

title: sarson da saag
instructions: wash mustard leaves and spinach thoroughly cook them in a pot with water until very soft allow to cool slightly then mash or blend coarsely heat oil in a pan add garlic ginger and green chilli cook briefly add the cooked greens salt and water mix well simmer on low flame add maize flour slowly while stirring to thicken cook for fifteen minutes stirring often turn off stove and serve hot

title: vada pav
instructions: boil potatoes until soft peel and mash them heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion softens add turmeric powder and salt mix well add mashed potato mix thoroughly turn off stove allow mixture to cool shape into round balls prepare batter by mixing gram flour salt and water to thick consistency heat oil dip each potato ball into batter and deep fry until golden slit bread place the fried vada inside and serve hot

title: rasgulla
instructions: boil milk in a pot add lemon juice slowly while stirring until milk curdles turn off stove strain the curds using a cloth rinse with water squeeze out excess water knead the curds until smooth form small balls boil water and sugar in a pot add the balls cover and cook on medium flame for fifteen minutes until they expand turn off stove allow to cool and serve

title: laal maas
instructions: soak dry red chilli in water and grind to paste heat oil in a heavy pot add garlic and onion cook until dark brown add red chilli paste and coriander powder stir on low flame add yogurt slowly while stirring add mutton and salt mix well add water cover and cook on low flame until mutton becomes soft and oil separates turn off stove rest before serving

title: fish paturi
ingredients: fish,mustard seeds,green chilli,turmeric powder,banana leaf,mustard oil,salt
instructions: clean and wash fish soak mustard seeds and grind with green chilli turmeric powder and salt into a thick paste coat fish pieces evenly place on banana leaf drizzle mustard oil wrap tightly steam for twenty minutes until fish is cooked remove carefully unwrap and serve hot

title: veg fried rice
instructions: cook rice separately with water and salt until grains are separate allow to cool heat oil in a pan add garlic ginger and green chilli stir briefly add vegetables cook on high flame until slightly tender add cooked rice and soy sauce mix gently stir fry for few minutes turn off stove and serve hot

title: moru curry
ingredients: yogurt,coconut,green chilli,cumin seeds,ginger,mustard seeds,curry leaves,coconut oil,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: whisk yogurt with water until smooth keep aside grind coconut green chilli cumin seeds and ginger with a little water to a smooth paste heat a pot on low flame add the ground paste turmeric powder salt and water cook gently for five minutes without boiling add the whisked yogurt slowly while stirring continuously keep the flame very low cook until the curry is warm and lightly thick do not boil heat coconut oil in a small pan add mustard seeds and let them splutter add curry leaves pour this tempering into the curry mix gently turn off the stove and serve warm

title: pumpkin erissery
ingredients: pumpkin,coconut,green chilli,cumin seeds,mustard seeds,curry leaves,coconut oil,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: peel pumpkin remove seeds and cut into medium pieces cook pumpkin with water turmeric powder and salt until soft grind coconut green chilli and cumin seeds to a coarse paste add this paste to the cooked pumpkin mix gently and cook for five minutes heat coconut oil in a small pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add curry leaves pour over the curry mix once turn off the stove and serve

title: shallot theeyal
ingredients: shallots,coconut,tamarind,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: heat coconut oil in a pan add coconut and roast on low flame stirring continuously until it turns dark brown allow it to cool and grind into a smooth paste soak tamarind in water and extract juice heat coconut oil in a pot add mustard seeds let them splutter add curry leaves and shallots cook until shallots soften add chilli powder coriander powder turmeric powder and salt mix well add tamarind water and bring to a boil add the ground coconut paste mix well and simmer on low flame for ten minutes turn off stove and serve

title: butter naan
instructions: add wheat flour yogurt yeast sugar salt and water to a bowl mix and knead into a soft dough cover and rest for two hours until it rises divide dough into balls roll each into oval shape heat a thick pan on high flame place the naan on the pan cook until bubbles appear flip and cook the other side until browned remove from pan apply butter on top and serve hot

title: fish thalipeeth
instructions: clean fish remove bones and mince it finely add rice flour onion green chilli coriander leaves turmeric powder salt and water mix to a soft dough heat a flat pan apply oil take a portion of dough place on pan and pat into a flat circle cook on medium flame until one side is crisp flip and cook the other side until fully cooked remove and serve hot

title: sambar sadam
ingredients: rice,toor dal,oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,onion,carrot,drumstick,tomato,sambar powder,tamarind,salt,water
instructions: wash rice and toor dal together until clean soak for ten minutes pressure cook rice and dal together with water until very soft mash lightly soak tamarind in warm water extract juice heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add dry red chilli curry leaves and onion cook until onion soft add vegetables and tomato cook for five minutes add sambar powder mix gently add tamarind water salt and cooked rice dal mixture mix well simmer on low flame for ten minutes stirring occasionally turn off stove and serve hot

title: kerala prawn curry
ingredients: prawns,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,shallots,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,tamarind,salt,water
instructions: clean prawns properly remove shell and vein soak tamarind in warm water extract juice heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add curry leaves shallots ginger and garlic cook until shallots soften add chilli powder coriander powder turmeric powder mix gently add tamarind water salt and water bring to a boil add prawns cook on medium flame until prawns are fully cooked and gravy thickens turn off stove and rest before serving

title: vegetable korma
instructions: grind coconut coriander leaves green chilli ginger and garlic with water to a smooth paste heat oil in a pan add onion cook until soft add the ground paste stir and cook for five minutes add vegetables salt and water mix well cover and cook on medium flame until vegetables are fully cooked sprinkle garam masala mix gently cook for two minutes turn off stove and serve

title: fish amritsari
ingredients: fish,gram flour,ginger,garlic,carom seeds,red chilli powder,lemon juice,oil,salt,water
instructions: clean and wash fish pieces add gram flour ginger garlic carom seeds red chilli powder lemon juice salt and water mix to thick batter coat fish evenly heat oil in a deep pan fry fish pieces on medium flame until golden and fully cooked remove drain excess oil and serve hot

title: jackfruit seed stir fry
ingredients: jackfruit seeds,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,garlic,black pepper,salt,water
instructions: wash jackfruit seeds remove outer skin cut into pieces cook with water and salt until soft drain and keep aside heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds let splutter add curry leaves onion and garlic cook until onion soft add cooked jackfruit seeds black pepper and salt stir fry on low flame until lightly roasted turn off stove and serve hot

title: parippu curry
ingredients: moong dal,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,coconut,green chilli,cumin seeds,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash moong dal thoroughly add dal turmeric powder salt and water to a pot cook on medium flame until the dal becomes very soft mash lightly grind coconut green chilli and cumin seeds with a little water to a smooth paste add this paste to the cooked dal mix well cook on low flame for five minutes heat coconut oil in a small pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add dry red chilli and curry leaves pour this tempering over the dal mix gently turn off the stove and serve hot

title: malabar chicken biryani
ingredients: basmati rice,chicken,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,yogurt,garam masala,chilli powder,turmeric powder,oil,salt,water
instructions: wash and soak basmati rice for twenty minutes wash chicken and marinate with yogurt ginger garlic green chilli chilli powder turmeric powder garam masala and salt for thirty minutes cook rice separately in salted water until seventy percent cooked drain and keep aside heat oil in a deep pot add onion and cook until golden brown add marinated chicken mix well cook until chicken is half done layer cooked rice over the chicken sprinkle a little water cover tightly and cook on very low flame until rice and chicken are fully cooked turn off stove allow to rest for ten minutes then mix gently and serve

title: jeera rice
instructions: wash basmati rice and soak for twenty minutes cook rice with water and salt until grains are soft and separate drain excess water heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds let them crackle add green chilli stir briefly add cooked rice mix gently on low flame for two minutes turn off stove and serve hot

title: paneer tikka
instructions: cut paneer into medium cubes mix yogurt ginger garlic red chilli powder garam masala lemon juice salt and oil into a thick marinade coat paneer evenly rest for thirty minutes thread paneer onto skewers or place on greased pan cook on medium heat turning occasionally until paneer is lightly browned and cooked remove and serve hot

title: mutton sukka
instructions: wash mutton thoroughly pressure cook with water and salt until soft heat oil in a pan add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns dark brown add chilli powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add cooked mutton stir thoroughly cook on low flame stirring often until the mixture becomes dry and coats the mutton turn off stove and serve hot

title: idiyappam
instructions: boil water with salt turn off the stove add rice flour slowly while stirring continuously until it comes together as a soft dough when warm grease idiyappam press with coconut oil fill the dough press the noodles onto greased idli plates steam in a steamer with boiling water for ten to twelve minutes until fully cooked remove carefully and serve hot

title: kerala chicken fry
ingredients: chicken,coconut oil,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,black pepper,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly add chilli powder black pepper turmeric powder salt and a little water mix well and keep aside for fifteen minutes heat coconut oil in a pan add onion ginger garlic and curry leaves cook until onion turns brown add marinated chicken mix well cook on medium flame until chicken releases water then continue cooking uncovered stirring often until chicken becomes dry well roasted and fully cooked turn off stove and serve hot

title: aloo paratha
instructions: knead wheat flour with water and salt into a soft dough rest for twenty minutes boil potatoes until soft peel and mash add green chilli cumin seeds and salt mix well divide dough into balls stuff each with potato filling roll gently into flat circles heat a pan apply oil place paratha cook on medium flame flipping and applying oil until both sides are golden brown remove and serve hot

title: uttapam
instructions: wash and soak rice and urad dal separately for six hours grind together with water into a thick batter add salt ferment overnight heat a flat pan grease lightly pour a ladle of batter spread slightly sprinkle onion and green chilli on top drizzle oil cook on medium flame until bottom is cooked flip carefully cook other side briefly remove and serve hot

title: gajar ka halwa
instructions: wash carrots peel and grate them heat clarified butter in a pan add grated carrot cook on medium flame stirring until soft add milk mix well cook until milk reduces add sugar and cardamom stir continuously until the mixture thickens and leaves the sides of the pan turn off stove and serve warm

title: kozhi varutharachathu
ingredients: chicken,coconut oil,coconut,shallots,ginger,garlic,curry leaves,chilli powder,coriander powder,black pepper,garam masala,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly and keep aside heat a pan add coconut and roast on low flame stirring continuously until it turns dark brown allow it to cool and grind into a smooth paste heat coconut oil in a pot add curry leaves shallots ginger and garlic cook until shallots turn brown add chilli powder coriander powder turmeric powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add chicken salt and a little water mix and cook on medium flame until chicken is tender add the roasted coconut paste mix well cook on low flame until gravy thickens and oil appears on top turn off stove and serve hot

title: kallappam
instructions: wash rice and soak for at least six hours grind rice with coconut and water to a smooth batter add yeast sugar and salt mix well cover and ferment for eight hours until batter becomes slightly fluffy heat a flat pan grease lightly pour a ladle of batter do not spread cover and cook on low flame until cooked through remove and serve soft

title: malabar fish biryani
ingredients: basmati rice,fish,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,yogurt,chilli powder,turmeric powder,garam masala,oil,salt,water
instructions: wash and soak basmati rice for twenty minutes clean fish and marinate with yogurt chilli powder turmeric powder garam masala and salt for twenty minutes cook rice separately in salted water until seventy percent cooked drain and keep aside heat oil in a pot add onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion soft add marinated fish cook gently until half done layer rice over fish sprinkle a little water cover tightly and cook on low flame until rice and fish are fully cooked turn off stove rest for ten minutes then serve carefully

title: chicken shawarma
instructions: wash chicken and cut into thin strips marinate with yogurt garlic lemon juice black pepper chilli powder turmeric powder salt and oil for one hour heat a pan cook the marinated chicken on medium flame stirring until fully cooked and slightly roasted warm flatbread on a pan place cooked chicken and cabbage roll tightly into a wrap cut and serve

title: vegetable fried rice
instructions: cook rice with water and salt until grains are separate spread and cool completely heat oil in a wok add garlic ginger and green chilli stir briefly add vegetables cook on high flame until slightly tender add cooled rice and soy sauce mix well stir fry on high flame for few minutes until well combined turn off stove and serve hot

title: porotta
instructions: add maida salt sugar oil and water into a bowl knead into a very soft and slightly sticky dough apply oil over the dough cover and rest for at least one hour divide into small balls apply oil and flatten each ball stretch as thin as possible without tearing fold into layers and roll into a spiral flatten gently heat a pan cook each porotta on medium flame applying oil flipping until both sides are golden and crisp remove from pan and gently crush between hands to separate layers serve hot

title: beef ularthiyathu
ingredients: beef,coconut oil,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,black pepper,chilli powder,garam masala,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash beef thoroughly cut into small pieces cook beef with water salt and turmeric powder until tender keep aside heat coconut oil in a pan add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns dark brown add chilli powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add cooked beef stir thoroughly cook on low flame stirring often until the beef becomes dry dark and well roasted with oil coating turn off stove and serve hot

title: chilli chicken
instructions: wash chicken and cut into small pieces mix with corn flour salt and a little water to coat evenly heat oil in a pan fry the chicken pieces on medium flame until golden and cooked remove and keep aside in another pan heat oil add garlic ginger and green chilli stir fry briefly add soy sauce and a little water bring to a boil add fried chicken mix well cook for five minutes until sauce coats the chicken turn off stove and serve hot

title: veg noodles
instructions: boil water in a pot add noodles cook until just soft drain and rinse with water keep aside heat oil in a wok add garlic ginger and green chilli stir briefly add vegetables cook on high flame until slightly tender add noodles soy sauce and salt mix well toss on high flame for few minutes until everything is well combined turn off stove and serve hot

title: chicken pizza
instructions: add maida yeast sugar salt water and oil into a bowl knead into a soft dough cover and rest for one hour until it rises cook chicken with onion garlic tomato and salt until fully done shred the chicken preheat oven roll the dough into a flat base place on tray spread the cooked chicken mixture evenly add cheese on top bake in preheated oven until the base is cooked and cheese melts remove cut into slices and serve hot

title: kerala beef biryani
ingredients: basmati rice,beef,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,yogurt,garam masala,turmeric powder,chilli powder,coconut oil,salt,water
instructions: wash and soak basmati rice for thirty minutes wash beef and cut into medium pieces marinate with yogurt ginger garlic green chilli turmeric powder chilli powder garam masala and salt for one hour cook beef in a pot with a little water until it becomes tender cook rice separately in salted water until seventy percent done drain and keep aside heat coconut oil in a deep pot add onion cook until golden add cooked beef mix well layer partially cooked rice over the beef sprinkle a little water cover tightly and cook on very low flame until rice is fully cooked and flavors combine turn off stove rest for ten minutes mix gently and serve

title: egg fried rice indian chinese
instructions: cook rice with water and salt until grains are separate spread and cool completely heat oil in a wok add garlic ginger and green chilli stir briefly add vegetables cook on high flame until slightly tender push vegetables to one side break eggs into the pan scramble until cooked add cooked rice and soy sauce mix well stir fry on high flame for few minutes until everything is combined turn off stove and serve hot

title: chicken burger indian style
instructions: wash chicken and mince or mash it mix with garlic black pepper and salt shape into patties heat oil in a pan cook the patties on medium flame until fully cooked and golden on both sides slice bread lightly toast on pan place cooked chicken patty inside add onion and cabbage close and serve hot

title: veg cutlet
instructions: boil potato carrot and beans until soft mash them together heat oil in a pan add onion and green chilli cook until soft add mashed vegetables black pepper and salt mix well allow mixture to cool shape into small patties heat oil shallow fry on medium flame until both sides turn golden brown remove and serve hot

title: neer dosa
instructions: wash rice and soak for five hours grind rice with coconut water and salt into a very thin batter heat a flat pan grease lightly pour batter quickly in a circular motion to form thin dosa cover and cook on low flame until done do not flip remove carefully and serve soft

title: chicken mandi kerala style
instructions: wash and soak basmati rice for thirty minutes wash chicken and marinate with yogurt garlic ginger black pepper turmeric powder and salt for one hour heat oil in a pot add marinated chicken cook until partially done remove chicken in the same pot add water and cook rice until almost done place chicken over rice cover tightly and cook on low flame until both are fully cooked turn off stove rest for ten minutes and serve

title: pathiri
instructions: boil water with salt add rice flour slowly while stirring to form a soft dough when warm knead lightly divide into small balls roll into thin flat circles heat a pan cook each pathiri on both sides until small brown spots appear do not overcook remove and keep covered serve hot

title: fish curry kudampuli
ingredients: fish,coconut oil,mustard seeds,fenugreek seeds,curry leaves,shallots,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,kudampuli,salt,water
instructions: soak kudampuli in warm water clean fish pieces heat coconut oil in a clay pot add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds let them splutter add curry leaves shallots ginger and garlic cook until soft add chilli powder and coriander powder mix gently add soaked kudampuli with water salt and extra water bring to boil add fish cook on medium flame until fish is done and gravy thickens rest before serving

title: paneer bhurji
instructions: crumble paneer into small pieces heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds let them crackle add onion ginger and green chilli cook until onion softens add tomato turmeric powder chilli powder and salt cook until tomato soft add paneer mix well cook on low flame for five minutes stirring occasionally turn off stove and serve hot

title: sweet lassi
instructions: add yogurt sugar cardamom and water into a bowl or blender mix well until smooth and slightly frothy taste and adjust sweetness pour into glasses and serve chilled

title: kozhi curry nadan
ingredients: chicken,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,garam masala,salt,water
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly and keep aside heat coconut oil in a pot add mustard seeds and let them splutter add curry leaves onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion turns golden add chilli powder coriander powder turmeric powder and garam masala mix well add chicken and salt stir and cook for five minutes add water cover and cook on medium flame until chicken is fully cooked and gravy thickens turn off stove and rest before serving

title: mutta dosa
instructions: wash and soak rice and urad dal separately for six hours grind into smooth batter mix together add salt and ferment overnight heat a flat pan grease lightly pour dosa batter spread slightly break an egg on top spread gently drizzle oil cook on medium flame until egg sets and bottom is crisp fold and serve hot

title: veg hakka noodles indian style
instructions: boil water in a pot add noodles cook until just soft drain and rinse with water keep aside heat oil in a wok add garlic ginger and green chilli stir briefly add vegetables cook on high flame until slightly tender add noodles soy sauce and salt mix well toss on high flame for few minutes until everything is combined turn off stove and serve hot

title: fish tikka
instructions: clean and wash fish pieces mix yogurt ginger garlic red chilli powder garam masala lemon juice salt and oil into a marinade coat fish evenly rest for thirty minutes preheat oven or heat a pan cook fish pieces turning occasionally until fully cooked and slightly charred remove and serve hot

title: ragi dosa
instructions: soak urad dal for four hours grind into smooth batter mix with ragi flour rice flour salt and water to form a thin batter rest for six hours heat a flat pan grease lightly pour batter spread into thin circle drizzle oil cook on medium flame until crisp flip briefly remove and serve hot

title: thalassery chicken biryani
ingredients: jeerakasala rice,chicken,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,yogurt,garam masala,turmeric powder,chilli powder,coconut oil,salt,water
instructions: wash and soak jeerakasala rice for twenty minutes wash chicken and marinate with yogurt ginger garlic green chilli chilli powder turmeric powder garam masala and salt for thirty minutes cook rice separately in salted water until seventy percent done drain and keep aside heat coconut oil in a pot add onion cook until golden add marinated chicken mix well cook until partially done layer rice over chicken sprinkle a little water cover tightly and cook on low flame until rice and chicken are fully cooked turn off stove rest for ten minutes then mix gently and serve

title: kadala roast
ingredients: black chickpeas,coconut oil,onion,ginger,garlic,curry leaves,chilli powder,black pepper,garam masala,salt,water
instructions: soak black chickpeas overnight and cook with water and salt until soft heat coconut oil in a pan add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns brown add chilli powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add cooked chickpeas stir and cook on medium flame until the mixture becomes dry and masala coats the chickpeas turn off stove and serve hot

title: paneer fried rice
instructions: cook rice with water and salt until grains are separate spread and cool heat oil in a wok add garlic ginger and green chilli stir briefly add vegetables cook on high flame until slightly tender add paneer cubes and cook for two minutes add cooked rice soy sauce and salt mix well stir fry on high flame for few minutes turn off stove and serve hot

title: mutton keema
ingredients: mutton,oil,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,tomato,red chilli powder,garam masala,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash minced mutton thoroughly heat oil in a pan add onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion turns golden add tomato cook until soft add red chilli powder turmeric powder and garam masala mix well add mutton salt and water mix thoroughly cook on medium flame stirring occasionally until mutton is fully cooked and mixture becomes dry turn off stove and serve hot

title: badam milk
instructions: soak almonds in water for a few hours peel the skin grind almonds with a little milk to a smooth paste heat milk in a saucepan add the almond paste sugar and cardamom mix well simmer on low flame for five minutes turn off stove and serve hot or chilled

title: meen peera
instructions: clean and cut fish into small pieces grind coconut with turmeric powder to a coarse mixture place fish in a pan add coconut mixture shallots green chilli ginger garlic curry leaves salt and a little water mix gently cook on low flame without stirring too much until fish is cooked and moisture reduces drizzle coconut oil mix gently turn off stove and serve hot

title: kozhi ada
instructions: cook chicken with water and salt until done shred the chicken heat coconut oil in a pan add onion ginger garlic green chilli and curry leaves cook until onion soft add shredded chicken and salt mix well prepare dough by mixing rice flour salt and hot water shape into small discs place chicken filling inside fold and seal steam in a steamer for fifteen minutes until fully cooked remove and serve hot

title: masala omelette
instructions: break eggs into a bowl add onion green chilli coriander leaves and salt beat well heat oil in a pan pour the egg mixture spread evenly cook on medium flame until bottom sets flip carefully cook the other side until fully done remove and serve hot

title: tomato soup indian style
instructions: wash tomatoes and cook with water until soft allow to cool blend into smooth puree heat oil in a pan add garlic cook briefly add tomato puree salt sugar and black pepper mix well bring to a boil simmer for ten minutes turn off stove strain if needed and serve hot

title: veg sandwich
instructions: slice vegetables thinly heat a pan apply butter on bread slices place vegetables on one slice sprinkle salt and black pepper cover with another slice toast on pan until both sides are crisp remove cut and serve hot

title: unniyappam
instructions: melt jaggery in a little water and strain to remove impurities mash banana in a bowl add rice flour coconut cardamom and jaggery syrup mix well to form a thick batter heat an appe pan add oil to each cavity pour batter into each cavity cook on low flame turning occasionally until all sides are golden brown remove and serve warm

title: chicken stew kerala style
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly heat coconut oil in a pot add cinnamon cloves and cardamom stir until aromatic add onion ginger and green chilli cook until onion softens add chicken potato salt and water mix well cover and cook on medium flame until chicken and potato are cooked reduce flame add coconut milk stir gently cook for two minutes without boiling turn off stove and serve

title: methi thepla
instructions: wash fenugreek leaves and mix with wheat flour yogurt green chilli turmeric powder salt and water knead into a soft dough divide into small balls roll into thin circles heat a pan cook each thepla on medium flame applying oil on both sides until cooked and slightly crisp remove and serve

title: fish manchurian
instructions: clean fish and cut into small pieces mix with corn flour salt and a little water coat evenly heat oil fry fish pieces until golden and cooked remove and keep aside heat a pan add oil garlic ginger and green chilli stir fry add soy sauce and a little water bring to a boil add fried fish mix well cook for five minutes until sauce coats the fish turn off stove and serve hot

title: mutta roast kerala
ingredients: eggs,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,garam masala,salt,water
instructions: boil eggs until fully cooked cool remove shells and cut in halves heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns dark brown add chilli powder coriander powder garam masala and salt mix well add a little water to form thick masala place eggs into masala coat well cook on low flame until masala sticks to eggs turn off stove and serve

title: neychoru
instructions: wash rice and soak for twenty minutes heat coconut oil in a pot add cinnamon cloves and cardamom stir add onion cook until soft add rice and salt mix gently add water bring to a boil cover and cook on low flame until rice is fully cooked and fluffy turn off stove rest for ten minutes fluff gently and serve

title: paneer tikka masala
instructions: grind tomato and cashew nuts into a smooth paste heat oil in a pan add onion ginger and garlic cook until onion softens add tomato paste cook until oil separates add red chilli powder garam masala and salt mix well add water to adjust consistency add paneer cubes simmer for ten minutes add cream mix gently cook for two minutes turn off stove and serve

title: chicken fried rice indian chinese
instructions: cook rice with water and salt until grains are separate cool completely cook chicken with water and salt until done shred into small pieces heat oil in a wok add garlic ginger and green chilli stir fry add vegetables cook on high flame add chicken and rice soy sauce and salt mix well stir fry on high flame until everything combines turn off stove and serve hot

title: sabudana khichdi
instructions: wash sabudana and soak in water for four to five hours until soft but not mushy heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds let them crackle add peanuts and cook until crunchy add potato and green chilli cook until potato soft add soaked sabudana salt and sugar mix gently cook on low flame stirring until sabudana turns translucent turn off stove and serve

title: egg biryani
ingredients: basmati rice,eggs,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,yogurt,chilli powder,garam masala,turmeric powder,oil,salt,water
instructions: wash and soak rice for thirty minutes boil eggs remove shells and keep aside heat oil in a pot add onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until golden add yogurt chilli powder turmeric powder garam masala and salt mix well add water bring to boil add rice and cook until rice is done place boiled eggs on top cover and cook on low flame for five minutes turn off stove rest and serve

title: veg pulao
instructions: wash rice and soak for twenty minutes heat oil in a pressure cooker add cumin seeds let them crackle add onion ginger and green chilli cook until onion softens add vegetables stir for two minutes add rice salt and water mix well close lid and cook until done allow pressure to release open fluff gently and serve hot

title: chicken momos indian style
instructions: prepare dough by mixing maida salt and water knead into soft dough rest for twenty minutes cook chicken with water and salt then mince finely mix with onion ginger garlic and green chilli divide dough into small balls roll into thin circles place filling in center fold and seal into dumplings steam in a steamer for fifteen minutes until fully cooked remove and serve hot

title: jeera soda
instructions: add lemon juice sugar salt and roasted cumin powder into a glass mix well add chilled water stir until sugar dissolves taste and adjust balance serve immediately

title: kozhukatta
instructions: boil water with salt add rice flour slowly while stirring to form a soft dough when warm knead lightly for filling melt jaggery with a little water strain add coconut and cardamom cook until thick cool slightly take small portions of dough flatten place filling inside shape into dumplings steam in a steamer for ten to fifteen minutes until cooked remove and serve

title: meen curry coconut
ingredients: fish,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,shallots,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,coconut,salt,water
instructions: clean fish pieces grind coconut with water to make coconut milk heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add curry leaves shallots ginger and garlic cook until soft add chilli powder coriander powder and turmeric powder mix gently add coconut milk salt and water bring to a boil add fish pieces cook on medium flame until fish is fully cooked reduce flame simmer for few minutes turn off stove and rest before serving

title: chicken sukka
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly heat oil in a pan add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns brown add chilli powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add chicken salt and a little water cook on medium flame until chicken is fully cooked then cook uncovered stirring often until dry and masala coats the chicken turn off stove and serve

title: paneer korma
instructions: grind coconut cashew nuts green chilli ginger and garlic into a smooth paste heat oil in a pan add onion cook until soft add the ground paste cook for five minutes add water and salt bring to a boil add paneer cubes simmer on low flame for ten minutes add garam masala mix gently turn off stove and serve

title: jalebi
instructions: mix maida yogurt and water into a smooth batter allow it to ferment for eight hours prepare sugar syrup by boiling sugar and water until slightly sticky heat oil in a pan pour batter in spiral shapes into hot oil fry until crisp remove and dip immediately into sugar syrup soak briefly remove and serve warm

title: pulissery
ingredients: yogurt,coconut,green chilli,cumin seeds,turmeric powder,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: whisk yogurt with water until smooth grind coconut green chilli and cumin seeds into a fine paste heat a pot add the ground paste turmeric powder salt and a little water cook on low flame for five minutes add the yogurt mixture slowly while stirring continuously keep the flame low and do not boil heat coconut oil in a small pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add dry red chilli and curry leaves pour over the curry mix gently turn off the stove and serve

title: cabbage thoran carrot
ingredients: cabbage,carrot,coconut,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,salt
instructions: wash and finely cut cabbage and carrot heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add dry red chilli and curry leaves add cabbage carrot and salt mix well cover and cook on low flame until vegetables are soft open and stir occasionally add coconut mix well cook for two minutes turn off stove and serve

title: vendakka mezhukkupuratti
instructions: wash okra thoroughly wipe completely dry and cut into pieces heat coconut oil in a pan add shallots and green chilli cook until soft add okra turmeric powder and salt mix well cook on low to medium flame stirring occasionally until okra is fully cooked and not sticky turn off stove and serve

title: parippu curry coconut
ingredients: toor dal,coconut,green chilli,cumin seeds,turmeric powder,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: wash toor dal cook with water turmeric powder and salt until soft mash lightly grind coconut green chilli and cumin seeds to a smooth paste add to dal mix well cook on low flame for five minutes heat coconut oil add mustard seeds dry red chilli and curry leaves pour over curry mix gently turn off stove and serve

title: mathanga curry
ingredients: pumpkin,coconut,green chilli,cumin seeds,turmeric powder,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: peel pumpkin remove seeds and cut into pieces cook pumpkin with water turmeric powder and salt until soft grind coconut green chilli and cumin seeds into a paste add to pumpkin mix gently cook for five minutes heat coconut oil add mustard seeds and curry leaves pour over curry mix well turn off stove and serve

title: chammanthi
instructions: add coconut shallots green chilli tamarind and salt into a grinder grind without adding much water to a coarse thick mixture scrape into a bowl mix well and serve fresh

title: pappadam
instructions: mix urad dal flour salt and water into a firm dough divide into small balls roll each into thin circles dry them under sunlight until crisp heat oil in a pan fry each pappadam until it puffs and becomes crisp remove and serve

title: kovakka mezhukkupuratti
instructions: wash ivy gourd and cut into thin pieces heat coconut oil in a pan add shallots and green chilli cook until soft add ivy gourd turmeric powder and salt mix well cook on low flame stirring occasionally until fully cooked and slightly roasted turn off stove and serve

title: sambar kerala style
ingredients: toor dal,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,shallots,drumstick,carrot,tomato,sambar powder,tamarind,salt,water
instructions: wash and cook toor dal with water until soft mash lightly soak tamarind in warm water extract juice heat coconut oil add mustard seeds dry red chilli curry leaves and shallots cook until soft add vegetables and tomato cook for few minutes add sambar powder mix well add cooked dal tamarind water and salt mix and boil on medium flame until vegetables are cooked and flavors combine turn off stove and serve

title: netholi fry
ingredients: anchovy fish,coconut oil,chilli powder,turmeric powder,black pepper,salt
instructions: clean anchovy fish thoroughly remove head and wash well add chilli powder turmeric powder black pepper and salt mix evenly keep aside for ten minutes heat coconut oil in a pan add fish and fry on medium flame turning carefully until crisp and fully cooked remove and serve hot

title: beetroot thoran
ingredients: beetroot,coconut,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,green chilli,salt
instructions: wash beetroot peel and cut into very small pieces heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add dry red chilli curry leaves and green chilli add beetroot and salt mix well cover and cook on low flame until beetroot becomes soft stir occasionally add coconut mix well cook for two minutes turn off stove and serve

title: cheera thoran
ingredients: spinach,coconut,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,shallots,green chilli,salt
instructions: wash spinach thoroughly and cut finely heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add dry red chilli curry leaves shallots and green chilli cook until shallots soften add spinach and salt mix well cook on low flame until spinach is fully cooked and moisture reduces add coconut mix well cook for two minutes turn off stove and serve

title: ulli theeyal
ingredients: shallots,coconut,tamarind,coconut oil,mustard seeds,curry leaves,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: heat coconut in a pan roast on low flame stirring continuously until dark brown cool and grind to a smooth paste soak tamarind in water extract juice heat coconut oil add mustard seeds let them splutter add curry leaves and shallots cook until soft add chilli powder coriander powder turmeric powder and salt mix well add tamarind water bring to boil add ground coconut paste mix and simmer on low flame for ten minutes until thick turn off stove and serve

title: kappa biryani
ingredients: tapioca,beef,coconut oil,onion,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,black pepper,garam masala,turmeric powder,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: peel tapioca remove thick skin cut into pieces wash thoroughly cook tapioca with water and salt until soft drain and mash lightly cook beef separately with water salt and turmeric powder until tender heat coconut oil in a pan add onion ginger garlic and curry leaves cook until brown add chilli powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add cooked beef and cook until dry mix mashed tapioca with beef masala cook on low flame for ten minutes until well combined turn off stove and serve

title: meen varuthathu
ingredients: fish,coconut oil,chilli powder,turmeric powder,black pepper,salt,curry leaves
instructions: clean fish thoroughly make shallow cuts mix chilli powder turmeric powder black pepper and salt apply evenly to fish keep aside for ten minutes heat coconut oil in a pan add curry leaves place fish and fry on medium flame until both sides are golden brown and fully cooked remove and serve hot

title: mutton curry kerala style
ingredients: mutton,coconut oil,onion,ginger,garlic,green chilli,chilli powder,coriander powder,garam masala,turmeric powder,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: wash mutton thoroughly pressure cook with water salt and turmeric powder until tender heat coconut oil in a pan add curry leaves onion ginger garlic and green chilli cook until onion turns brown add chilli powder coriander powder and garam masala mix well add cooked mutton with some stock cook on medium flame until gravy thickens and oil separates turn off stove and serve hot

title: vegetable pasta indian style
instructions: boil water in a pot add pasta cook until soft drain and keep aside heat oil in a pan add garlic ginger and onion cook until soft add tomato cook until mushy add vegetables salt and black pepper cook until vegetables soften add cooked pasta mix well cook for two minutes turn off stove and serve hot

title: chemmeen roast
ingredients: prawns,coconut oil,onion,ginger,garlic,curry leaves,chilli powder,black pepper,turmeric powder,garam masala,salt,water
