instructions: clean prawns remove shell and vein wash thoroughly heat coconut oil in a pan add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns brown add chilli powder turmeric powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add prawns and salt stir and cook on medium flame until prawns release water then cook uncovered until dry and masala coats the prawns turn off stove and serve hot

title: thair sadam
instructions: cook rice with water until soft allow it to cool mash slightly add yogurt and salt mix well heat oil in a small pan add mustard seeds urad dal green chilli and curry leaves let them splutter pour over the rice mix gently and serve

title: aloo jeera
instructions: boil potatoes until soft peel and cut into cubes heat oil in a pan add cumin seeds let them crackle add green chilli and turmeric powder mix well add potatoes and salt toss gently cook on low flame until lightly roasted turn off stove and serve

title: fish curry tamarind
ingredients: fish,oil,mustard seeds,fenugreek seeds,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,tamarind,salt,water
instructions: clean fish thoroughly soak tamarind in warm water extract juice heat oil in a pan add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds let them splutter add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until soft add chilli powder coriander powder and turmeric powder mix gently add tamarind water salt and water bring to boil add fish cook on medium flame until fully cooked and gravy thickens turn off stove and rest before serving

title: vegetable sandwich grilled
instructions: slice vegetables thinly apply butter on bread place vegetables sprinkle salt and black pepper cover with another slice heat a pan or grill place sandwich cook on medium flame pressing gently until both sides are crisp remove cut and serve hot

title: fish moilee
ingredients: fish,coconut oil,onion,ginger,green chilli,turmeric powder,coconut milk,curry leaves,salt,water
instructions: clean fish pieces and keep aside heat coconut oil in a pan add onion ginger green chilli and curry leaves cook until onion softens add turmeric powder mix gently add water and salt bring to a boil add fish pieces cook on medium flame until fish is done reduce flame add coconut milk stir gently cook for two minutes without boiling turn off stove and rest before serving

title: chicken ularthiyathu
ingredients: chicken,coconut oil,curry leaves,onion,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,black pepper,garam masala,turmeric powder,salt,water
instructions: wash chicken thoroughly cook with water salt and turmeric powder until tender heat coconut oil in a pan add curry leaves onion ginger and garlic cook until onion turns dark brown add chilli powder black pepper and garam masala mix well add cooked chicken stir and cook on low flame until dry and roasted with masala coating turn off stove and serve hot

title: beans thoran
ingredients: beans,coconut,coconut oil,mustard seeds,dry red chilli,curry leaves,green chilli,salt
instructions: wash beans and cut into small pieces heat coconut oil in a pan add mustard seeds let them splutter add dry red chilli curry leaves and green chilli add beans and salt mix well cover and cook on low flame until beans are soft stir occasionally add coconut mix well cook for two minutes turn off stove and serve

title: tomato rasam
ingredients: tomato,toor dal,mustard seeds,cumin seeds,black pepper,garlic,dry red chilli,curry leaves,tamarind,salt,water
instructions: cook toor dal with water until soft mash lightly soak tamarind in water extract juice crush cumin seeds black pepper and garlic boil tomato tamarind water with crushed spices and salt add dal water mix well simmer for ten minutes heat oil add mustard seeds dry red chilli and curry leaves pour into rasam mix and serve

title: chapati
instructions: mix wheat flour salt and water knead into a soft dough rest for twenty minutes divide into small balls roll into thin circles heat a pan cook each chapati on medium flame flipping until both sides are cooked and light brown spots appear remove and serve hot
